research_notes: Initial research1 October2026. Official occupations supplemented with historical local government records, charity annual reports/appointments, regulatory and association governance evidence, public professional-profile leads and first speech.

No substantive full-time evidence found for SA Health or council intervals. Do not count nominal chronological span as years, and do not infer fractions from executive titles. Month-level transitions may overlap and leave remains unresolved.

Pre-December2005career is incomplete. SA Divisions role is undated; first-person introduction describes longer non-clinical health work, and Probus Marion reports rural doctor recruitment work as another lead. No invented early employers, roles or continuous employment. Education BASc, MA, MPH and MBA is not paid work.

Vinnies resignation conflict retained explicitly: annual report p7states September2022; official occupation and employer31 August2022release state September2021, and July2022first speech says former employer. Treat2022annual-report date as likely error without deleting source evidence.

APH mental-health submission direct open was restricted; AHPRA2016page403; UniSA2017alumni profile timeout400; public LinkedIn https://au.linkedin.com/in/louisemillerfrostboothby open Internal Error. Indexed primary evidence used only for explicit facts; no authenticated content or access-control bypass.

Further leads: historical SA Divisions and SA Health annual/staff reports for early work and working fraction; Burnside Corporate Services title in15 April2014audit agenda; precise Catherine House transition; SAPMEA/TGA/AMC term/pay; AWL start; Churchill selection role; separate/overlapping project work.

A secondary interests-register page mentions Sarah Group Holdings advisory membership but may concern another declared family interest; identity and original declaration not verified, so not added as her employment. Campaigning after September2021is not assumed paid employment or evidence of no other work.

All governance and advocacy roles are recorded separately from public health and council employment. Unknown pay is not volunteering, and incomplete private-sector evidence is not a zero-year total. Research remains blocked pending gaps.

Follow-up2026-10-02: first-person House speech confirms previously lead-only doctor recruitment work. Retained separately with possible duplication because exact employer/dates and relationship to existing SA Health posts are unresolved. Rounded15years not used to back-calculate career start or full-time totals.

Primary council records confirm Corporate Services portfolio and add SAPHC representative governance/resignation beforeApril2017. Searches for early workforce/recruitment and SA Divisions history did not establish applicable payroll or full-time evidence. Burnside/West TorrensPDF403 and Probus502 treated as source gaps; narrow indexed evidence identified explicitly. Remaining health/council leave, board terms and private-sector gaps retained.

Follow-up2026-10-03: public professional-profile indexing supplied a3-year9-month SA Divisions duration and fuller Primary Mental Health Care title. Because exact months and substantive hours remain unavailable, the profile duration was recorded as evidence but not converted into endpoints or headline years. Searches for a primary payroll record and for the Country Health doctor-recruitment role did not resolve those gaps.

Follow-up2026-10-04: AMC primary member table narrows council departure toJanuary2022. Trust primary annual report separately establishes national-board retirement at end of its31January2022financial year; month precision retained and SA chair role distinguished from National Chair. Official parliamentary indexing adds UCWB board membershipFebruary2010–April2017,EBEC2014–2017,EDA SA committee2015–2016,SA MET2020–2022,national Churchill board2021–2022,plus SAPHC deputy2015–2017. These omitted governance roles are separate from employee appointments and cannot resolve personal working fraction. Full AMC PDF exceeded tool length; APH403; narrow explicit indexed evidence recorded. Early health/recruitment employer and existing hours/leave gaps remain unresolved.

Primary school newsletter adds Belair governing council observation;2014council agenda adds disputed Urban Services portfolio attribution without manufacturing a second employment spell. ERA committees, UCWB subcommittees and mentoring dates appeared only in a derivative profile and remain leads pending own-profile/institutional confirmation. Council departmental staffing tables are planned position complements, not proof of personal fraction/leave; direct PDFs403. Targeted full-time and doctor-recruitment searches found no employment-contract evidence. Earlier health employer/hours, council acting arrangements and charity transition remain unresolved; no totals calculated.
